purpose: Teach: 買わ/積ん/はいる/移る/直っ/治り/片付ける/歩ける

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、それ、もう買わなくていいわよ
lines.en: Sho, you don't need to buy that anymore.
lines.style: Calm, practical instruction. Natural maternal tone—not stern, but clear about what needs to happen. Gentle finality, like she's decided this for both their good.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんが本を積んでるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's stacking his books again.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to himself. Matter-of-fact delivery. A small noticing that he's sharing because it struck him—not a complaint, just a fact he wanted to tell her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんがお部屋にはいるわよ
lines.en: Sho, Grandma's in your room right now.
lines.style: Gentle warning delivered without alarm. Warm but purposeful—she's letting him know before he goes in, like she's looking out for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくのおもちゃ、隣に移るよ
lines.en: Mom, my toys are going to move next door.
lines.style: Quiet acceptance mixed with practical certainty. He's stated it like he's already worked it out. No resistance, just telling her what he's figured.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお怪我、もう直ったわよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's injury is all better now.
lines.style: Reassurance delivered simply. Warm maternal relief—she's been waiting to tell him this. Steady voice, no rush.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖父ちゃんの治り、早かったね
lines.en: Mom, Grandpa got better really fast, didn't he?
lines.style: Small wonder in his voice. Noticing something good and wanting confirmation. Quiet marvel—like he's surprised and pleased by something adults might not think twice about.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お部屋を片付ける時間よ
lines.en: Sho, it's time to tidy up your room.
lines.style: Practical maternal direction. Not negotiable, but not harsh. The tone of someone who has said this before and will say it again, with gentle consistency.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、もう歩けるようになったよ
lines.style: Quiet pride. Simple, direct statement—not boasting, just telling her something true about himself. Slight lift at the end, like he's pleased to share it.
